This **chezmoi dotfiles repository** manages configuration across machines.
Source: `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`; target: `~/`; repo: https://github.com/pascalandy/dotfiles.
`chezmoi apply` copies desired state to home (not symlinks).

Files in `~/` that are managed by chezmoi should NEVER be edited directly.
Always edit the source in `~/.local/share/chezmoi/` or use `chezmoi edit`.
`chezmoi managed | grep <filename>`
`chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc`
`chezmoi add ~/.newfile`
`git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push`

Naming: `dot_` → dotfile; `private_` → `600`/`700` permissions (visible in git); `executable_` → executable; `symlink_` → symlink; `.tmpl` → process `{{ }}`; `run_before_` → before apply; `run_after_` → after every apply; `run_once_` → first apply only.

Prefer user scripts in `~/.local/bin/`:
`code ~/.local/bin/[script-name]`
`chmod +x ~/.local/bin/[script-name]`
`chezmoi add ~/.local/bin/[script-name]`
Stored as `dot_local/bin/executable_[script-name]`. Ensure `~/.local/bin` is in PATH (add to `.zshrc` if needed):
`export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"`
Script names should NOT have `.sh` extension.

Bash scripts follow `dot_config/opencode/skill/bash/scripts/pref_bash_script_template.sh` and `set -euo pipefail`. Naming: `fct_*` functions, `log_*` logging, `UPPER_CASE` constants/env vars, `lower_case` locals. Use `log_info "Starting process"`, `log_error "Something failed"`, `local message="${1:-Unknown error}"`, `local exit_code="${2:-1}"`, `log_error "${message}"`, `exit "${exit_code}"`.

Repository layout includes `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `dot_zshrc` → `~/.zshrc`, `dot_gitconfig` → `~/.gitconfig`, `dot_Brewfile` → `~/.Brewfile`, `dot_local/bin/` → `~/.local/bin/`, `dot_config/` → `~/.config/`, `private_dot_ssh/` → `~/.ssh/`, `private_dot_gnupg/` → `~/.gnupg/`, `.chezmoiscripts/` (v2.9+; `run_before_sync.sh` syncs VS Code/Brewfile; `run_after_backup.sh` backs up external files), and archived `bienvenue_chez_moi/` (source: `~/Documents/github_local/Z_ARCHIVED/`).

Files containing `{{ .variable }}` MUST have `.tmpl` extension (e.g. `opencode.json.tmpl`). Define variables in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml` (e.g. `openrouter_api_key = "sk-or-v1-.."`). Inspect managed output with `chezmoi cat ~/.zshrc`.

Run scripts also update VS Code extensions, back up external files, and copy `bienvenue_chez_moi`. `.chezmoiignore` excludes `node_modules/`, `__pycache__/`, `.env*`, `.DS_Store`. See `crash_procedure.md` for recovery. Docs: https://www.chezmoi.io/user-guide/command-overview/

cass indexes conversations across coding agents. Before solving a problem from scratch, check if any agent already solved something similar.
⚠️ NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
`cass search "authentication error" --robot --limit 5`
`cass view /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 --json`
`cass expand /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 -C 3 --json`
`cass capabilities --json # Feature discovery`
`cass robot-docs guide # LLM-optimized docs`

Use `--fields minimal` for `source_path, line_number, agent`; `--limit N`; `--agent NAME`; `--days N`. `--robot / --json` gives required machine-readable JSON. stdout=data; stderr=diagnostics; exit 0=success.
